messages:
Priya S.: Hey all, first week checklist — my monitor arrived but the stand mount screws are missing, and I'm hitting a wifi cert error when trying to join 'redwood-employee'. Shipping shows "delivered" to SF-reception. Order RDW-7021. Who do I bother for screws and wifi?
Tom (buddy): Welcome Priya! :wave: Ping @Rachel - Facilities for hardware and @Lee (IT) for wifi certs. Reception sometimes holds small parts.
Rachel - Facilities: Hi Priya 30 can check delivery manifest. Can you drop the exact model/serial from the packing slip? If screws are missing we can either send a hardware kit or you can grab a replacement screw pack from Desk Services (Bldg A).
Priya S.: Packing slip has monitor model ViewMax 27 - SN VMX27-9981. I attached the pic in DMs. Reception says they only signed for a "box".
Lee (IT): For the wifi error, what's the popup text? On mac/linux we usually enroll via the internal SSO cert portal: https://internal.it.redwood/enroll. If you see "ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID" or "unknown issuer" try this helper first:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/rw-enroll --force
```
If that fails send me the console output.
Priya S.: Error reads: "Trust anchor for certification path not found". Ran helper -> "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority". I'm on macOS 13.5.
Lee (IT): Ok filed IT ticket IT-2026-4620 for mac-support. Quick remote check: open Keychain Access -> login -> import the corp_root_ca.crt (I can DM it) -> set trust to "Always Trust" for that cert. If you prefer, I'll remote. Are you on-site?
Priya S.: On-site at SF desk F3 now. A remote would be great. Also, any chance for a temporary stand? My monitor is propped on books rn :sweat_smile:
Rachel - Facilities: We've got screwkits in the office supply closet. I asked Desk Services to drop by with a screw pack and a temporary mini-stand. Replacement order OR-2026-321 created if the screwpack isn't compatible. ETA 3 hours.
Chris (manager): Hey Priya 30 looping in for visibility. If you need immediate peripherals let me know and I can approve expedited replacement. Welcome aboard! :tada:
it-bot: Ticket IT-2026-4620 created -> Status: Open. SLA: 4 hours.
Lee (IT): Scheduling a quick remote session at 11:15 to import the CA and re-run enroll. Will DM a calendar invite. Meanwhile you can try:
```
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /path/to/corp_root_ca.crt
```
Priya S.: Thanks everyone 30 I'll be at the desk and will join the remote session. Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll update this thread after the fix.
